metric: Delivered road transport cost, ZAR per litre; illustrative only
cost_source: Authored illustration, not carrier quotes or validated cost evidence
cost_definition: Dispatch allowance plus generalized road/connection distance times an illustrative transport rate. Excludes fuel purchase price, tax, storage and pipeline tariffs. No pipeline or rail cost is claimed.
graded_surface_method: Shortest distance along inherited schematic road segments plus straight-line origin and destination connections, transformed into illustrative transport cost. Cells beyond the connection limit or without a connected route remain unassessed. Not operational routing or validated cost.
meaning: A graduated illustrative road transport cost surface from Durban or Lesedi, clipped to mainland South Africa; not a verified customer catchment or tariff map
condition: Candidate service requires compatible product, operational capacity, receipt/dispatch capability, transport access, delivered cost and customer rights
owner: Manish assembles route/customer evidence; Nigel reviews interpretation
replace_when: Operational routes and customer destinations are available, before claiming measured reach
